anti_generic_signature_read: Posing a long tactile pet and giving it different moods appears to be the central experience. Pastel colors, pink external gills, prominent eyes, tiny feet, and repeated dorsal accents make it friendly and playful.
blind_action_read: The three panels show a straight body with open round eyes, a strongly curved body with closed cheerful eyes, and a shallower curved body with a third open-eyed expression. The visibly different face graphics suggest selectable expressions, while the body poses suggest manual bending. The images do not establish how expressions are changed or whether movement causes an expression change.
blind_form_read: The isometric view establishes a thick rounded rectangular head, three thick pink gills on each side, small dark conical projections near the neck-facing corners, rounded tall body lobes with pink top accents and raised dorsal nubs, cylindrical intermediate links, flat feet, and a faceted tail. The cream face panel is shallowly raised within the mint frame.
blind_held_read: A mint and pink articulated creature or desk fidget with a square cream face panel, six pink side gills, a long linked body, four tiny feet, and pointed tail. The gills now suggest an axolotl-like fantasy creature, combined with a robot or screen-faced character. Exact handheld scale is still unknown.
blind_relationship_read: The head, neck link, repeated body joints, four feet, and tail read as a continuous object. Body joints visually explain the changing silhouette. The cream panel's edge and border grooves suggest a separate face insert. A causal connection between body curvature and expression is not evident from stills.
blind_subjects_read: One friendly hybrid creature, most plausibly an axolotl-like articulated fantasy pet. The head has a deliberate screen or interchangeable-card appearance.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Before reveal, round 2 recognized an axolotl-like fantasy pet from six external gills, a thick rounded head, rounded body lobes and friendly face. Small dark horns and dorsal accents provide the dragon component.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Chunky, friendly axolotl-dragon hybrid invented from text.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Blind round 2 identified open round eyes in the straight configuration. Iso shows two large charcoal eye disks with pale highlights and a curved smile.
Blind round 2 explicitly recorded six pink gills, three thick blades on each side of the head.
Blind round 2 recorded two small dark conical projections near the neck-facing corners of the head; iso presents them as short blunt horns.
Blind round 2 recorded continuous head, neck, repeated rounded lobes and cylindrical intermediate links, four tiny feet, and a tapering pointed tail.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Segmented body and tail forming an articulated chain.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The blind action read identified straight and two curved configurations. The blind experience read identified posing a long tactile pet. These are static intended articulation states; physical movement, travel and retention remain unverified under check_motion=false.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Intended wiggle, coil and fidget experience.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The corrected blind read identified mint body and pink external gills and dorsal accents. The viewed pointed tail carries the same pastel coral/pink fin.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Mint body with coral gills and tail fins.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The blind form read identified the cream face panel. Pale cream lower-edge strips are visible in the viewed iso beneath the head and body/tail. The full underside is occluded; this is evidence of the visible cream belly edge, not a measurement of its entire coverage.
The blind form read recorded dark conical horns and tiny feet; the viewed iso shows dark marks across the toe ends consistent with claw accents.

Before reveal, round 2 identified a separate cream insert and three face graphics: round open eyes and smile, closed cheerful eyes, and a third open-eyed expression. Following reveal, closed eyes fit the sleepy alternative and the third face has angled brows consistent with softened anger. All occupy the same head pocket. Still images do not prove swapping or latch function.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Swappable face plate with happy, sleepy and angry alternatives.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The blind relationship read recognized the same continuous creature with a separate cream panel in three pose/expression presentations. It did not infer that bending causes an expression change. The revealed independent manual face exchange matches this relationship.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Expression changes belong to the same creature; manual face exchange and manual posing.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The blind held read recognized a desk fidget with a large head and compact linked body. No ruler or hand is shown, so exact length is not visually measured; the concept specifies 180 mm and numerical dimensions remain a separate CAD check.

Blind round 2 recognized clean discrete mint, pink, cream and dark regions without painted texture. The revealed concept selects AMS/MMU volumetric regions. The visual palette matches; manufacturing method is not certified by a render.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Four colors without paint, through the allowed AMS/MMU or separate-color part approach.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Both blind rounds used only the product stills and read an invented creature. No reference image or likeness score was used.

Iso shows unobstructed joint gaps and the complete linked object without scaffolding. This visible form is consistent with the intent. Bound digital wall and overhang checks pass; no physical print, clean release or working motion is claimed.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Unsupported print-in-place chain without added visible support structures.

largest_risk: Motion, clean first-print release, snap retention, durability and user response remain unverified. Closed sleepy eyes initially read as cheerful closed eyes, and angry brows are less obvious at overview scale, but the three graphics are distinct. Digital thickness/overhang checks do not prove physical success.
resolution: Round 1 withheld a pass because renders had striping and missing triangles. Fresh corrected exact-state renders were inspected in round 2 before Wish reveal; the failures remain preserved in engineering/blind-read.json and blind-read-r2.json. After reveal, the thick gilled/horned creature, linked tail, four-color regions and face alternatives match the brief. Intended use is manual posing and manual face exchange, with no coupled expression actuation. The static form/signature passes. Physical printing, release, durability and motion remain unverified. The completed integrated CAD verifier passed; all 32 current thickness/overhang reports are bound. Independent administrative audits by <HOME>/contract_reconciliation preserve the original critic findings and two-round count: the concept now enumerates the four existing coupon roles, with all 16 packaged canonical STEP copies identical to verified CAD and both review images unchanged. All 32 generated reports remain verbatim prefixes of the annotated files; clearly attributed legacy RESULT summaries restate measured PASS rows, with only optional hollowing warnings. See engineering/contract-reconciliation.json and engineering/report-compatibility-review.json. Full prior review text is preserved in engineering/signature-review-before-bounded-resolution.json. No new blind review, measurement or physical claim is added.
